Title: Beginner’s Guide To Getting Started Efficiently
Author: Kena

Title: Everything you need to know in one place

Title: MetalKid's Normal Mode Guide
Author: MetalKid
Content:
Setup Steps

  1. Place 3 units down. If more than 1 is an Egg or Gonkid, place a 4th unit or re-roll one - They should all be placed along the top row. If you get another one, re-roll one when you have magic stones.
  2. Upgrade Common units to level 2.
  3. Release the Thief right away.
  4. If you have 2X speed, message your partner that you are doing 2X until wave 10. Some people hate 2X and some demand it, but the first 10 waves are pretty "boring" and not difficult to keep up at 2X speed. If your partner wants more, they will tell you at this point. :)
  5. Get 7-10 slime miners.
  6. Place common units until it fills up the board. This is to get as many missions filled as possible.
  7. You must get the hidden Caboodle mission for commons. If the board is full and you still don't have it, start combining units you have at least 3 copies of. If you run out of those, then start re-rolling. At this point, you may want to go down to 1X speed temporarily (or permanently).
    • You should also get the Go-go Ga-ga mission by having 3 Eggs on the board at the same time - it is actually quite a bit of Gold.
  8. Once you get the first hidden mission, get the second one for all rares. Use a similar strategy as you did for commons.
  9. Once you get both hidden missions, combine all your rares into epics, filling in the gaps to upgrade to as many epics as possible.
  10. Once the bounty is possible again, upgrade common units to level 10 and then release - this should be enough to defeat it.
  11. It is possible that you get the third hidden mission - but if you don't, you may try to re-roll once or twice - then ignore and combine everything on the board as far as it goes.
  12. You should get one or two demon gods out of this. Once you get the first one, keep re-rolling until you get a mimic.
    • If you get 4+ legendaries, you may need to re-roll to get the match.
    • If you don't get a mimic when you have around 60 magic stones left, you may want to just evolve it into an Oni or Cat if you ended with the right unit.
  13. Once you get the resources from the mimic(s), try to re-roll to get at least 4 mimics in total. They don't have to be all in a row, but it is better if you can.
  14. Spend all of the gold from the first mimic getting out more units and combining them to get more demon gods quicker.
  15. Once the second mimic and above finish, buy slime miners until you get down to about 450 gold. Then use the rest to continue upgrading.
  16. If you end up with a bit of magic stones to spare after the 3rd mimic, buy a level or two in Demon God upgrades. Only but Demon God upgrades - don't bother with anything else now.
  17. Continue with mimics and maxing out miner slimes while combining units to get demon gods. The next part will describe the configurations to use.
  18. Once you get at least one Oni/Cat, you can keep getting higher and higher bounties except the last one - wait until you have Ice Knight out first.

Beginner Setup

If you haven't beaten the last wave yet, you may want to use this setup. Destroyer at A1 will help you or your partner, depending on how far mobs are getting. If you don't have relic for Cat, then use 6 Onis instead. Oni relic isn't required, but makes it a lot easier.

If you want to use a Helicopter to make things a bit easier, place one less Witch Doctor. The Witch Doctor placement isn't important, but the rest are.

Higher Level Setup

Once you have relic for Cat and your Witch Doctor is around level 5 or so, you should be able to win without using Destroyers. However, if your partner is super low level, move A1 Oni to C3 and put a Destroyer on A1 instead. That way, it can reach to your partner's side at the start of their path (but not yours) if things stop working out. If you want a Helicopter, put one less Witch Doctor on the board.
